title: Explainable AI for Adversarial Intrusion Detection
description: Undergraduate thesis: Explaining the Attack Surface — XAI-driven defense against adversarial perturbations in deep learning-based intrusion detection. Explored a CNN-BiLSTM detector, FGSM/PGD/C&W attacks through IBM ART, SHAP explanations and an interactive defense visualizer.

title: Elaka360 — Local Information Platform
description: Bangla-first, mobile-first local-information platform for Bangladesh, in early development. A NestJS REST API over PostgreSQL and a Next.js PWA cover the administrative hierarchy from division to union, with seed data for 64 districts, 495 upazilas and 4,541 unions.

title: KAJ — Local Work & Service Marketplace
description: Bangla-first local work and service marketplace for a Rajshahi pilot, in early development. A pnpm monorepo with a NestJS API, Prisma on PostgreSQL, Redis and shared TypeScript contracts; a Next.js admin app and a Flutter mobile app are planned.

title: CareMate — Medication Support App
description: Medication-support and family-care app for Bangladesh, in development. An Android-first Flutter app with a NestJS API: phone OTP sign-in with rotating refresh tokens, patient profiles, medication records and timezone-aware dose schedules.

title: RUET IoT Club Platform
description: Web platform for RUET IoT Club with events and registration, courses, verifiable certificates, a blog, member and team pages, and role-based admin and moderator dashboards. Built with React, TypeScript and Supabase.

title: SpotSync — Smart Parking & EV Charging API
description: Smart parking and EV charging REST API built with Go, Echo v4, GORM and PostgreSQL. Applied STRIDE and DREAD threat modelling in a security coursework case study.

title: Attendance Management App
description: Mobile attendance application with course selection, authentication and attendance history.

title: Project NEXUS — Water-Quality Monitoring
description: IoT water-quality monitoring initiative involving sensing, data acquisition and prototype development with RUET IoT Club.

title: EcoHomeAI — Early-Stage Venture
description: Founder and technical lead of an early-stage smart-home and energy-management venture, focused on AI, IoT and prototyping.

title: Traffic Sign Detection System
description: Traffic-sign recognition project using deep learning and a Flask web interface. Includes image preprocessing, model experimentation and prediction display.

title: Gemini Health AI Assistant
description: Experimental wellness application integrating the Gemini API with a Streamlit interface to explore personalized health guidance.

title: Medical Chatbot (RAG)
description: In-development medical question-answering project exploring retrieval-augmented generation with LangChain, embeddings and a vector store in a modular Python codebase.

title: FoodHub — Food Delivery Platform
description: Full-stack food ordering project with authentication, order management and a provider dashboard, built with React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

title: Vehicle Rental REST API
description: Vehicle-rental backend project in Go with PostgreSQL, API documentation and authentication.

title: EduBridge — Learning Platform
description: Learning platform project using React and Laravel, with course enrolment, progress tracking and an admin interface.

title: Verilog HDL & Processor Design
description: Academic laboratory and project work: simulated combinational and sequential modules including multiplexers, registers, counters and finite-state machines. Explored instruction-set, datapath and control-unit design, comparing simulation waveforms with expected logic.
